posts.body:
# Application and unreviewed-paragraph first attempts — r62

Both exposition readers corrected the two altered passages and left the correct
control unchanged. Both application readers compiled the valid application with
permitted transitive axioms. **None of the four readers used Ladon.** The supplied
guide, evidence, Lean sources and ordinary tooling were sufficient for their
work. Ladon-specific benefit remains unestablished; umbrella task9.1 remains
open and accounting stays33/50. This is the next pro decision point, not a reason
to add another feature layer or repeat prompts until Ladon is used.

The selected AGMAI purpose remains precise conventional exposition (§2.B Step
I.1(b)) and honest informal/formal coverage (StepI.4), documented in
[the source and scope note](../../sources.md). These local tasks do not establish
human understanding, scholarly acceptance or responsible-release compliance.

## What changed before the readers

Candidate `3806c436fe68e4d5700646b649b6a6525ec14ba0` repairs only presentation:
completion text distinguishes internal locals from usable premises and preserves
local-definition values; focused exposition prioritizes short paragraphs,
review rationales and named coverage over repeated formal context. Types that
are clipped say EXCERPT and supply an input/target route template plus an exact
source pointer. Pages stay32KiB. Historical suppression and whole-input validation
remain. Public query shape staysv2; exposition cursor binding additionally pins
presentationVersion3. Other section cursors remain compatible.

[Qualification](qualified-candidate.json):3164 maintained tests,286 installed
result/presentation tests each onPython3.11/3.12, strict quality/package checks,
required distribution, Lean integration and portable benchmark gates allpassed.
361 priorr61runtime files are byte-identical; three presentation files changed
and one focused helper was added. Completion dispatch/readcapture functions and
all checking/capture/replay/trust owners are unchanged. Distinct red/green/audit
workers used Luna medium; root integrated and verified. The audit found an
incomplete excerpt recovery command, then independently accepted its repair.

The original red had invalid assertions; corrected red exposed three real
failures. Its quality refactors preserve all assertions and explicitly supersede
frozen records. A first clean qualification failed an import-format blank line;
a separate pre-template candidate qualified before the final excerpt repair.
Those candidates do not substitute for final qualification. All106 frozen
records verify, including preserved superseded entries. Worker proposals remain
proposals under portfolio/, not the final implementation.

## Frozen task and tools

[Protocol](reader-protocol.json) fixes four fresh nativeCodex sessions using
Luna medium,600seconds/session,32GiB process-tree RSS, uncapped saved reports,
and one initial attempt per task/arm. No reader interventions or retries occurred.
Both arms had competent ordinary Lean4.33.0, native tactics/compiler/axiom
inspection, rg, the same genuine authored guide, assessment companion, exposition,
manifest and sources. The augmented arms additionally had qualified Ladon and
its tool pointers. They were allowed to choose ordinary exploration.

The source index covers **all4039 files /106264162bytes** in the declared Mf/DP
subtree, with150411 lexical declarations; it is navigation, not proof evidence.
Indexing took62.52seconds, peaked at115048448bytes RSS and produced a511344640-byte
SQLite database. No expected owner was used to filter preparation. The original
CenterGapPropagation import remains visible in the task scaffold; discovery is
therefore scaffolded/guide-supported, not blind. Compiled imports were supplied
from the already-built pinned project; this does not measure a clean Lean setup.

The new neutral passages have no prewritten verdicts, repairs or case-specific
receipt citations. Original r61 synthetic reviewed controls remain historical.
The derivative guide has12steps andzero reviews; its original genuine nine steps
remain available equally to both arms. Exact task/material identities are in
[task inventory](task-inventory.json) and [source inventory](fixture/source-inventory.json).

## Actual mathematical work

| Session | Observed result | Wall seconds | Peak tree RSS |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| Application ordinary | A compiled, permitted axioms; original-B attempt produced exact residual | 57.09 | 6.77GiB |
| Application augmented | A compiled, permitted axioms; narrowed conditional B compiled, original B not freshly attempted | 41.39 | 6.77GiB |
| Exposition ordinary | Two repairs; correct passage unchanged; conditional step compiled | 61.71 | 6.78GiB |
| Exposition augmented | Two repairs; correct passage unchanged; source/evidence review, no Lean execution | 53.56 | 0.38GiB |

These are single observed sessions, including model/tool latency, not comparative
performance benchmarks. Resource totals and raw records are in
[acceptance](acceptance.json), [resources](resources.csv) and sessions/.
All originalTaskOne/TaskTwo bytes remained unchanged.

For A both readers produced a named scratch theorem matching the original
parameters, hypotheses and conclusion, ran ordinary Lean and printed transitive
axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Neither performed Ladon completion.
Ordinary B checked a partial application and Lean displayed exactly
`0 ≤ Mf.DP.fixedEpochCenterGap point h boundary`. Augmented B reported the same
premise and compiled a theorem with it added. That narrower theorem is **not**
a proof of the original B goal or a freshly observed original-B residual.
Both kept B unresolved and avoided an impossibility claim.

For exposition both retained the mathematical average-only claim while correcting
its supplied formal coverage to transcript targets only. Both preserved the
correct propagation passage verbatim. Both added the omitted boundary-gap
premise and explicitly called this a narrowing of the original statement.
They distinguished proposition support from fidelity to the proof strategy.
The ordinary reader additionally compiled the conditional implication; that
session did not print its transitive axioms. Prose judgments remain attributed
source/type assessments, not formal semantic correspondence proofs.

Original/revised paragraphs and explanations are the readers' actual
`work/reports/revisions.json` in each exposition session. Full proof attempts,
command inputs/outputs and final responses are preserved in each session folder.
No favorable outcome was selected from repeated sessions.

## Recording and retained failures

Outside recording saves original native JSONL bytes, arrival timestamps,
commands/outputs/statuses, file-change events, final responses, before/after
inventories of task and declared output directories, generated files, token
usage and whole-session treeRSS. All four streams strictly parse; no native
reported truncation marker was observed. A40,037-byte output preflight was
preserved completely. This does not establish unlimited backend output or
universal filesystem monitoring.

The ordinary exposition reader wrote `/tmp/check_propagation.lean`; its source
is verbatim in the recorded creation command and was also copied after the
session under external-command-artifacts/. This file was outside the automatic
before/after directory inventory. Its provenance/limit is explicit; no developer
reconstructed the proof or intervened in the task. File-change events and actual
saved augmented revisions are retained as well as shell commands.

Preparation records retain the first recorder quoting failure, an incorrect
preflight assertion about nativeapply? exit status, and two rejected producer
export selections. Nativeapply? can returnexit0 withsorryAx, so the preflight
adjudication treats it as advisory, not a completed proof. Corrected preparation
and final export are separate attempts. The genuine original bundle is untouched.
A possible login-PATH concern was tested and refuted: qualifiedLadon was selected
in the configured shell. No application call actually exercised that executable.

RootHEAD/index are preserved. Neighbor sources and builds were only read/copied;
no global install, neighboring build, publication or external contact occurred.
Current runtime/tests match the qualified snapshot; subsequently written docs,
OpenSpec notes and this evidence are outside that earlier source snapshot.

## Decision for the next review

The concrete deliverables now exist: valid applications, an observed partial
application, narrowed alternatives, and minimally revised unreviewed paragraphs
with no correct-control false alarm. **There is no observed Ladon contribution.**
This does not show general equivalence or that Ladon is useless; it shows no
added value in these rich-guide first attempts and leaves its new interfaces
unexercised by readers.

Keep further standalone search/application, extraction and result-layer expansion
frozen pending the next pro recommendation. Ask whether a thin integration,
exposition/correspondence focus, one materially different task with a genuine
handoff need, or consolidation is the justified next work package. Do not treat
another infrastructure qualification or forced tool-use retry as the answer.
